name: Everyday Points
summary: Understand flexible points and how grocery, travel and entertainment spending may earn rewards.
plainEnglish: Points programs can allow statement credits, travel or gift cards, but one point need not equal one cent for every redemption.
watchOut: Check minimum redemption amounts, expiration policies and whether certain purchases earn base rather than bonus points.
limitations: Fictional program; redemption options are explanatory examples and not an issuer promise.
